title: Laplace posterior over Mirror functional coordinates
hypothesis: For one trained shared MLP plus a low-dimensional Givens view code m, a posterior restricted to m provides held-out predictive NLL and calibration close to subnetwork/full diagonal Laplace while materially reducing actual serialized posterior bytes and sampling latency.
physical_object: One MAP shared MLP θ and one Givens feature-view m inserted before the readout.
mirror_coordinate: Sixteen learned Givens angles over 32 hidden feature coordinates.
logical_multiplicity: Posterior samples over m induce multiple predictive functions without independent full-network posterior draws.
dataset: UCI Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer (WDBC), via sklearn load_breast_cancer; 569 rows, 30 features, binary target.

split.method: stratified nested random split; train 60%, dev 20%, fresh 20%

development.training: one shared MLP with Givens m, Adam full-batch; maximum 300 updates, stop after 40 non-improving dev NLL epochs; best dev checkpoint retained.
development.selection_metric: development NLL, with ECE as tie-break; choose λ separately per approximation family
development.fixed_outcome: Four Laplace methods selected prior precision using dev NLL/ECE; all selected λ=100. Best Laplace dev control is subnet_full. The frozen_config.json records this before fresh access.

controls: Independent 5-member MLP ensemble as practical upper compute/bytes control.

storage.authority: actual torch.save serialized inference payload bytes
paid_objects: One shared_base.pt with θ mean weights and train-fit standardizer (charged once).
Per-method actual serialized posterior state: m mean plus all covariance/variance tensors needed for that method.
Independent 5-model upper control stores all five full network states.
Architecture, class mapping, prior precision and sampler metadata.

success_gate: Fresh NLL within 0.02 nats and ECE-10 within 0.02 of the best Laplace control, while the code-space marginal posterior state uses at least 4x fewer actual serialized bytes than the full diagonal posterior state and 100-sample predictive wall time is at least 2x lower; total shared-base+state bytes are also reported.
failure_gate: FAIL if Mirror posterior misses best Laplace control by >0.02 NLL or >0.02 ECE, or if its marginal posterior state is not at least 4x smaller or predictive wall time misses the 2x gate. Structured full-covariance m must beat diagonal m to claim a structured-curvature benefit.
boundaries: One small tabular classification benchmark; no broad BNN claim.
Curvature controls use empirical Fisher/Gauss-Newton Laplace; not exact Hessian.
View angle code is optimized on train, with MAP trunk trained jointly.
Fresh split will not be used for λ/configuration selection.
